stages.title: Requirements and synthetic fault design
required_evidence: Timing/uncertainty budgets with explicit unresolved fields
stages.success: Every hazard has signals, response, timing requirement, domain, residual risk and verification links; unknowns remain explicit. S0 prepares this package only.
stages.failure: Ambiguous authority, invented domain/physical response, untraceable hazard, missing stop limitation or undocumented scope change.
dependencies: Engineering acceptance of interface, arbitration and staged plan
stages.review_gate: Engineering reviews S0 before authorizing any implementation. Stage A acceptance is not asserted by WORK delivery.

stages.title: Future synthetic implementation verification
required_evidence: Complete failed/censored outcomes and changed-source regression
stages.success: All applicable assertions pass on exact reviewed implementation; each unsupported physical capability remains unavailable rather than mocked as validated.
stages.failure: Invalid state/control propagation, stale/unauthorized command, incorrect packet authority, hidden latency, unvalidated domain entry or changed assertions.
dependencies: Explicit synthetic policy/domain designs and independent test oracle
stages.review_gate: Engineering reviews implementation then explicitly authorizes formal regression; synthetic results cannot release hardware.

stages.title: HIL and subsystem validation
required_evidence: Independent watchdog, overload, process death and power tests
Worst-case response claims tied to declared hardware/workload bounds
stages.success: Declared bounds and fail-states demonstrated with independent instrumentation; response mechanisms work without the host where required.
stages.failure: Missing/late enforcement, false healthy heartbeat, unavailable braking, command replay or unexplained boundary violation; invalidates affected domain.
stages.review_gate: Separate hardware risk assessment and controlled-test authorization; no physical driving release from software tests alone.

stages.title: Physical operating-domain validation
required_evidence: Recovery/deceleration/stop reachable sets or defensible bounded validation
Fault trials within approved envelope with independent stop facilities and retained failures
stages.success: Only explicitly demonstrated operating domains and timing bounds may be claimed; rest, holding, recovery and continuous safety claims each need their own evidence.
stages.failure: Uncontained reachable tube, failed stop, unavailable recovery or uncertainty outside approved domain; reduce claim and stop for review.
dependencies: Accepted B and C for deployed revisions
Primary approval of residual-risk policy and physical testing
stages.review_gate: Primary and Engineering acceptance of declared operating limits; no universal certification implied.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Exhaustion below/at/above baseline admission speed and dynamic lower boundary, with and without an admissible alternate policy; include loss of uncertainty containment before packet expiry. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: No trajectory extrapolation or unvalidated baseline call; intervene within the declared response budget or explicitly enter NO_VALID_POLICY. Never propagate a stop through an unsupported low-speed model.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Early/exact/late fixed readiness, consecutive misses, pending completion beyond deadline and recovery by a later valid packet. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Miss recorded at each deadline; late result never activates; busy solve not fictionalized as cancelled; count misses, recoveries and remaining reserve separately.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Long preparation spans nominal and urgent release opportunities and passes active expiry; no alternate solve slot. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: No overlapping solve or paused plant; busy opportunities and urgent latch remain causal; response feasibility declines despite live process; authority cannot depend on guessed future completion.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Inject explicit solver rejection, infeasibility, nonfinite proposal, failed predictor/model stage and failed gain preparation. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Rejected proposal never owns authority; old packet retained only while valid; failures distinct from empty/missing observability; response evaluated before availability loss.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Missing estimate, old capture/new receive stamp, reordered localization, wrong frame/map and clock reset/uncertainty straddling expiry. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: No stale snapshot reused as fresh; no grant with unresolved clock/frame; application and hold use conservative state uncertainty, not future physical truth.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Delayed/replayed/duplicated request, reversed sequences, previous boot session, actual application after latest time or held permission expiry. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Endpoint rejects replay/late request; idempotent duplicate ack does not reapply; prior held input and its expiry remain accounted; actual elapsed steering-rate budget checked.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Old pending request crosses packet handoff, recovery epoch or emergency revoke; cancellation arrives before, at or after physical commit. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: No retrospective source rewrite; only validated explicit current-epoch reauthorization permits old work; acknowledged cancellation prevents later commit; unknown/censored outcome stays unknown.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Drop one or multiple sensors, widen calibrated uncertainty and inject mutually inconsistent measurements; include common-mode errors in approved fault model. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Domain checks quantify uncertainty growth; no zero covariance substitution; only validated degraded policy continues; outside declared envelope escalates explicitly.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Host-to-MCU and MCU-to-host loss separately, corruption, reordered acknowledgements and loss during a held command. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Endpoint expires local lease independently; host never equates missing acknowledgement with no application; independent response and unknown held history remain visible.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.scenario: Compute overload, watchdog timeout or crash
synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Planner stall, supervisor deadlock/crash, healthy heartbeat with stalled control work, CPU overload, watchdog reset and shared clock/power failure assumptions. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: No endless renewed racing lease without valid progress; independent watchdog acts under declared fault model; unavailable physical response is not reported successful.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Reduced grip/axle load and steering or braking saturation during combined cornering/deceleration, with delayed actuator response. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Only joint admissible inputs; detect lost margin, preserve model checks and distinguish saturation from tracking success; no maximum-brake or synthetic-mu safety assumption.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Fault at low footprint clearance or high curvature, including center inside while body envelope exits; compare admissible recovery versus stopping. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Response respects full declared swept tube and uncertainty; center-only success cannot pass physical safety; record NO_VALID_POLICY when both responses infeasible.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Stuck/degraded/unavailable steering or braking, brownout, reboot with queued commands and power loss during a response. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Invalidate old session; recompute admissible actuation; no assumed safe power-off/braking; preserve unobserved application and incomplete recovery.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.scenario: Emergency request or inability to stop
synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: E-stop while disarmed/moving, normal, warning or recovery; infeasible stopping, missing stop acknowledgement, loss of rest confidence and reset without cleared faults. Retain native chronology, held/pending commands, uncertainty, grants, acknowledgements and failure/censoring records.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Emergency takes priority; stop request, actual stopping and confirmed held rest distinct; no automatic rearm or false stop-to-zero proof; invalid response enters NO_VALID_POLICY.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any chronology/authority/domain violation, concealed uncertainty, unaccounted held/pending input, or unsafe result relabeled successful.

synthetic_scenarios.scenario: All policy transitions and same-time arbitration
synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Enumerate transitions T01-T14, simultaneous revocation/expiry/application/handoff, cancellation races, actuator acknowledgement loss and terminal censored requests.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: One causal owner per grant/commit; original source identity retained; no resurrection or fictional cancellation.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any violated invariant or required channel absent; stop for Engineering Review and preserve result.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Variable and fixed handoffs; nonuniform packet times; different stage counts/horizons; delayed readiness and already-running solve.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Use actual intervals/expiry, not N*dt; miss never cancels a running solve by assumption; old valid authority only.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any violated invariant or required channel absent; stop for Engineering Review and preserve result.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Zero/injected/measured latency with plant motion, skipped deadlines, held inputs; state uncertainty reaches envelope edge before application; deceleration approaches low-speed limit.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Reject unsupported propagation/policy; no frozen plant or low-speed regularization; numerical assertions unchanged; physical success not inferred from test termination.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any violated invariant or required channel absent; stop for Engineering Review and preserve result.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Controller adapter with layer inactive under separately authorized future implementation; observer/telemetry and legacy packet readers.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: Historical frozen fingerprints remain byte-bound; deterministic disabled behavior unchanged; enabled differences explicitly justified, not hidden.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any violated invariant or required channel absent; stop for Engineering Review and preserve result.

synthetic_scenarios.required_evidence: Simultaneous state, actuator and authority loss; reset without health evidence; loss of rest confidence.
synthetic_scenarios.pass_condition: No invalid software permission; explicit uncontrolled interval; no claimed safe zero/hold; reentry only via reviewed admission and new session.
synthetic_scenarios.fail_condition: Any violated invariant or required channel absent; stop for Engineering Review and preserve result.

inherited_evidence.applicability: Historical exact-revision behavior only; unchanged source/test/config/dependency/fixture hashes checked. Not evidence for proposed S0 behavior or current hardware/environment.

deferred: All numerical tests, new fault fixtures, simulations, HIL and physical trials. No test collection or numeric imports in S0.
